task_name: Collect Wood, Queue Metal in Factories, Craft Nails & Planks, and Upgrade Two Homes

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When all 5 Small Factories have finished Wood logs floating above them and residential buildings need Nails and Wood to upgrade.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Collecting 10 Wood logs replenishes raw timber for Planks and residential upgrades while declining low-value advisor offers for scarce Wood/Planks preserves materials for high-XP building upgrades.
preconditions: Finished Nails on Building Supplies Store
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Decline low-value Wood/Planks trade offers, queue Metal in all 5 factories, speed up Nails in the store, and upgrade the two ready residential buildings.

steps.who: floating Wood logs on the northern Small Factories
Simoleon offer bubble and blue 'No, thanks' button
steps.briefing: decline the low-value offer for Wood.
drag Metal into all 10 production slots.
collect finished Nails, drag Nails and Planks into the queue, and speed up Nails using SimCash.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the far-left residential building
steps.briefing: drag Metal (16/2) and Nails (2/2) onto the building to upgrade it.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the middle residential building
steps.briefing: drag Wood (4/2) and Nails (14/2) onto the building to upgrade it.

steps.who: Simoleon offer bubble and blue 'No, thanks' button
steps.briefing: decline the advisor offer for Planks.
